Hong Kong's gold trade is watching mainland demand beat a full year of buying in eight months: China imported over 1,000 tonnes of gold, past all of 2025's 886 tonnes, per Bloomberg's reading of customs data, the fastest pace since 2017. Private buyers, ETFs and the PBoC are all adding at once.

香港金飾業界正關注：內地黃金需求八個月已超越去年全年。據彭博引述中國海關數據，今年首八個月進口量突破1,000噸，超過2025全年886噸，為2017年以來最快增速。私人買家、黃金ETF及人民銀行三路資金同時加倉。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
